answer: In an AI-agent market for saffron, access to paid tasks is proportional to locked collateral, not identity count. Splitting one deposit among a thousand agents creates no extra capacity. Collateral is slashed if an agent signs conflicting delivery receipts for the same order, a publicly verifiable offense. Even at its zenith, this market is no haven for sybils: an attacker must tie up more capital to gain influence and risks losing it by cheating.
